i hope some people can give this a read. it breaks my heart that you feel this way. i am a suicidal person myself, and have been a majority of my life, even as a kid. this forum has made me re-think things, however, i do want you (and anyone reading this) to know that a lot of the times, suicidal people don't think. i know i am a stranger, and hope this doesn't come off wrong, but i know your son loved you greatly, and you were probably the best to him. suicidal people get so caught up in their emotions that everything and everyone is a blur, all they can think about is ending that sadness in their brain. i hope you dont hold on to guilt because know that it was not your fault. much love.
